entities.name: NAD(P)HX repair candidate 510 aa
observations: Submitted 510-aa sequence; estimated mass 54.3 kDa and theoretical pI 4.62.
Likely bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme by homology: NAD(P)HX epimerase and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase; candidate annotation is not experimentally established for this sequence.
Top reviewed homolog B5YIM0 has 32.5% identity over 97.8% query coverage (E-value 8e-73); additional reviewed Nnr homologs have 33.7–35.3% identity.
Potassium is reported as a cofactor in homolog annotations; not confirmed directly for the submitted sequence.

entities.name: UniProt B5YIM0 Nnr
observations: Reviewed Thermodesulfovibrio yellowstonii bifunctional NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme; annotated for NAD(P)HX epimerization and ADP-dependent dehydration, with potassium binding.
